QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Delivering Results
QuestInfo.0: Leon completed his investigation and wanted to meet with you.
QuestInfo.1: Leon wanted to report back to Gilberto after completing his investigation.
QuestInfo.2: Leon wanted to report back to Gilberto after completing his investigation. Leon delivered his findings first and reported on the marvelous plants and ores in the area. You added the details about Riverson and the Delfinos hideout, and Gilberto thanked you for your work.

0.0: Okay, the information on the deep ends of the canal is all ready.\r\nShall we head to see my father?

yes.0: Let's go back to my father!

no.0: Do you need time to get your information together? Talk to me when you're ready!

1.msg: Yes, Prime Minister! There were a lot of novel plants and ores inside of the barrier. They will surely be quite useful to us and the townspeople.

3.msg: Yes, sir! I found the Delfino Hideout in the deep end of the barrier. And Riverson was there as well.

yes.0: You found the Delfino Hideout, and Riverson to boot... Your hard work is most appreciated! Thank you very much!

npc.0: Let's go report to my dad!
